tags: harsh lighting, washed out, high contrast, pale, grim
note: Silver-retention look: crushed contrast with colour almost gone but not fully (0.28, so skin still reads as skin). Distinct from the existing bleach preset, which is contrast 1.35 / saturation 0.45 and does not sharpen - this one keeps less colour and adds a mild unsharp for the gritty edge bleach bypass is actually wanted for. Measured SATAVG 39.1 -> 11.4.
